chunks: If they accuse you of falsehood, (remember that) the people of Noah, 'Ad and Thamud had accused (their apostles) before,

key_terms.يُكَذِّبُوكَ: They accuse you of falsehood/reject you

ai.seo_question: Which previous nations rejected their prophets before the people of Muhammad (SAW)?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Hajj, this verse reassures the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) by citing the historical precedent of Noah, 'Ad, and Thamud, whose rejection of their messengers preceded the Meccans' disbelief. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a confirmation of the continuity of prophetic experience, emphasizing that divine truth remains constant despite varying degrees of societal resistance. The mention of these specific nations underscores the universal pattern of 'inkar' (denial) faced by all prophets, validating the Prophet's steadfastness.
